decisions.reason: The switch from Stripe to Coinbase Commerce applies only to the fiat on-ramp; the Brevo transactional email provider remains unchanged.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not alter email-based dashboard authentication, magic links, or its intended users.
The fiat on-ramp provider switch does not change unauthenticated access to public referral statistics.
The source changes only the fiat payment provider and does not modify commissions or ticket awards for referral-code mints.
The source does not change the random reward behavior for mints made without a referral code.
The payment-provider replacement does not entail any change to NFT ticket counters or permanent badges in metadata.
The source does not alter random winner selection, ticket eligibility, or ticket weighting.
The fiat on-ramp provider switch does not affect secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
